summary: Retire the unused Claude catalog launch entrypoints

replay.detail: Current native launch, adoption, channel admission, observation and transcript recovery remain unchanged.

schema.detail: No stored or wire format changes and no historical data cleanup.

rules.detail: Current primary ownership, native session binding, immutable-hook compatibility and residency checkpoint validation remain unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Removes the unused workspace-internal catalog run and run_residency_attempt APIs, their private launch body and old st2 channel argument builders. Current callers retain the explicit-path native launch and adoption APIs.

downtime.detail: No active provider restart is required.

manual.detail: No operator action or data cleanup is required.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the unused source entrypoints without rewriting stored state.
